text: A vector filed D = a_r(cos² φ)/R³ exists in the region between two spherical shells defined by R=1 mm and R=2mm. Evaluate: (i) ∮ D·dS, and (ii) ∫ ∇·D dv.

A charge density ρ_s C/m² is uniformly spread over the area of a disk of radius 'a'. Determine the force on a charge 'q' that is placed a distance from the center of the disk and on a line that is perpendicular to the disk.
In what ways does the electric field intensity vary with distance for (i) a point charge and (ii) an electric dipole?
Write Maxwell's equation for electrostatics that relates electric flux density with charge density. Obtain the equation from Gauss's law.
A uniform volume charge density of 80 µC/m³ is present throughout the region 8mm < r < 10mm. Let ρ_v = 0 for 0 < r < 8mm. Find the total charge inside the spherical surface, r = 10mm.
A potential function of V = 100 + 50ρ + 150ρ sin φ volts exists within a cylinder of ρ = 2, 0 < z < 1. Find the electric flux density D at the point P(1, 60°, 0.5) in free space.
Using Ohm's law in electrostatics, derive the expression of resistance of a conductor in terms of its physical properties while carrying current due to an applied uniform electric field.
What do you understand by polarization vector? Explain writing its equation. Calculate the electric susceptibility of a material in which the electric flux density is 3 times the polarization.
In free space, let ρ_v = 200 (ε_0 / r^2.4) C/m³. Use Poisson's equation to find V(r) if it is assumed that r² E_r → 0 when r = 0 and V → 0 as r → ∞.
Define vector magnetic potential A. What is the relation between magnetic flux density B and vector magnetic potential A? Give an example of a situation in which B is zero and A is not.
A hollow conducting cylinder has inner radius 'a' and outer radius 'b' and carries current 'I' along the positive z-direction. Find H inside and outside the hollow conductor.
Using Ampere's circuital law, obtain Maxwell's curl equation for magnetostatic fields. State with necessary expression how this curl equation differs in time varying fields.
What are the differences while a plane wave propagating through a perfect dielectric medium and propagating through a good conducting medium? Explain your answer by writing equations.

Let the fields E(z, t) = 1800 cos(10⁷ πt - βz) a_x V/m and H(z, t) = 3.8 cos(10⁷ πt - βz) a_y A/m represents a uniform plane wave propagating at a velocity of 1.4 x 10⁸ m/s in perfect dielectric. Find (i) β, (ii) λ (iii) η (iv) μ_r and (v) ε_r.
Derive the wave equation for electric field in free space.
Define phase velocity and group velocity. On what ways is group velocity different from phase velocity?

The E field of a uniform plane wave propagating in dielectric medium is given by E(z, t) = a_x 2 cos(10⁸ t - z/√3) - a_y sin(10⁸ t - z/√3) V/m. (i) Determine the frequency and wavelength of the wave. (ii) What is the dielectric constant of the medium? (iii) Describe the polarization of the wave. (iv) Find the corresponding H field.
A uniform plane wave in lossy medium has a phase constant of 1.6 rad/m at 10⁷ Hz and its magnitude is reduced by 60% for every 2m travelled. Find the skin depth and speed of the wave.
Define reflection coefficient and transmission coefficient. Deduce relationship between them.

A uniform plane wave in air is normally incident on an infinitely extended lossless dielectric media having ε = 3ε_0 and μ = μ_0. If the incident electric field E_i = 10 cos(ωt - z) a_x V/m, calculate (i) ω and λ of the wave in both media, (ii) reflection and transmission coefficient.
State how a waveguide differs from free space in case of plane wave propagating through it.
What is an evanescent mode? Discuss the general attenuation behavior caused by wall losses as a function of frequency for the TE_10 mode in a rectangular waveguide.

A rectangular waveguide operating at the S band with dimension a=7.21 cm and b=3.40 cm. What mode types can be used to transmit electromagnetic waves having the following wavelengths? (i) λ=10 cm, (ii) λ=5 cm.

Calculate and compare the values of β, u_p, u_g and λ_g for a 2.5cm x 1.5cm rectangular waveguide operating at 7.5 GHz: (i) if the waveguide is hollow, and (ii) if the waveguide is filled with a dielectric medium characterized by ε_r = 2, μ_r = 1, σ = 0.
Define steam boiler. Explain the construction and working principle of a simple vertical boiler with the help of suitable sketches.
Explain the functions of blow off cock and feed check valve.

The following observations were made on a boiler plant during one-hour test: Steam pressure = 20 bar; Steam temperature = 260°C; Steam generated = 37500kg; Temperature of water entering the economizer = 15°C; Temperature of water leaving the economizer = 90°C; Fuel used = 4400kg; Energy of combustion of fuel = 30000 kJ/kg. Calculate (i) The equivalent evaporation per kg of fuel (ii) The thermal efficiency of the plant and (iii) The percentage heat energy of the fuel energy utilized by the economizer.
Discuss the working principle of a four stroke cycle petrol engine with the help of neat sketches.
Discuss the cooling requirement of an I.C. engine. Describe the different methods of cooling.

During the test on single cylinder oil engine, working on the four stroke cycle and fitted with a rope brake, the following readings are taken: Effective diameter of brake wheel = 630 mm; Dead load on brake = 200 N; Spring balance reading = 30 N; Speed = 450 rpm; Area of indicator diagram = 420 mm²; Length of indicator = 60 mm; Spring scale = 1.1 bar per mm; Diameter of cylinder = 100 mm; Stroke = 150 mm; Quantity of oil used = 0.815 kg/h; Calorific value of oil = 4200 kJ/kg. Calculate brake power, indicated power, mechanical efficiency, brake thermal efficiency and brake specific fuel consumption.
Distinguish between open cycle and closed-cycle turbine.
Explain why high temperature flue gas cannot be used in the compressor?

A gas turbine operates with temperature limits of 490°C and 950°C. The energy input in the high temperature exchanger is 280 kW. Determine the air flow rate per min. If the compressor front and rear pressure are 4 kPa and 30 kPa, respectively then determine the efficiency.
Define comfort. What are the factors which affect comfort air conditioning?
Draw a block diagram of a simple year round air conditioning system.
Draw the layouts of vapour compression refrigerating system. State the function of each component.
Define gross head, net head and efficiency of turbine.
Define draft tube. Describe different types of draft tubes with neat sketches.

A Pelton wheel is having a mean bucket diameter of 1 m and is running at 1000 rpm. The net head on the Pelton wheel is 700 m. If the ride clearance angle is 15° and discharge through nozzle is 0.1 m³/s, find (i) Power available at the nozzle, and (ii) Hydraulic efficiency of the turbine.
Write a short note on condenser, compressor and evaporator.
Why throttle valve is important in refrigeration system? What will happen if there is no throttle valve in a refrigeration system?
What is fluid machinery? How it differ from fluid mechanics?
Define cavitation. How can it be avoided in reaction turbine?
Differentiate between an inward and outward flow reaction turbine.

Determine the power given by the Jet of water to the runner of a Pelton wheel which is having tangential velocity as 20 m/sec. The net head on the turbine is 50 m and discharge through the Jet water is 0.03 m³/sec. The side clearance angle is 15° and take C_v = 0.975.
List the compressible and incompressible machines used in a fluid machinery.
Distinguish fans, blower and compressor. When should you use a centrifugal pump?
Describe the working principle of typical reciprocating pump with neat sketch.
What are universal gates? Why is it called so?
Draw the logic circuit diagram of TTL-OR gate and explain its operating principle.
A Boolean expression is given as F = xy + x̄z. Represent the function, F, as SOP and POS.
What is the difference between a BCD and a binary?
Simplify the following expression using mapping: f = Σm(0, 8, 10, 13, 15) + d(2, 5, 6, 14)
Implement a full-subtractor by using i) Half-subtractor, and ii) type-0 multiplexer
Simplify the following function using Quinn McCluskey method, f = Σm(0, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 10, 13).
Explain the function performed by the following logic circuit: [Circuit diagram showing a network of three 4-to-1 Multiplexers]
Prove that, A + ĀB = A + B using Boolean theorems.
Explain with suitable example how adder circuit can be used for both addition and subtraction.
Implement the following functions using 3 x 8 decoder and some other necessary gates, F_1(A, B, C) = Σm(1, 2, 4, 7), F_2(A, B, C) = Σm(3, 5, 6, 7)
In what aspects, a priority encoder differs from the conventional encoders.
Differentiate between combinational and sequential logic circuit with examples.
Form a partial differential equation by eliminating the function φ from z = y² + 2φ(1/x + log y).
Obtain the equation of surface satisfying 4yzp + q + 2y = 0 and passing through y² + z² = 1, x + z = 2.
The current density in a semiconductor device is governed by the partial differential equation (PDE): (∂J/∂x)² + (∂J/∂y)² = J. Solve this PDE using Charpit's method.
Solve the following higher order linear partial differential equations: (D³ - 2D²D' - DD'² + 2D'³) = e^(x+3y)
Solve the following higher order linear partial differential equations: (D² - D'² + D - D') = e^(x+3y)
Applying the method of separation of variables, find the solution of the following equation: 4(∂u/∂x) + (∂u/∂y) = 3u and u = e^(-5y) when x = 0.

Consider the following differential equation arising in the analysis of nonlinear electrical circuit: x²(d²y/dx²) + x(dy/dx) + (x² - 4)y = 0. Identify the type of differential equation and verify that x = 0 is a regular singular point.
Use the Frobenius method to find the indicial equation and its roots.
Obtain the general solution for y(x) using the Frobenius series approach.
Prove that J_3/2(x) = sqrt(2/πx) (sin x / x - cos x).
Show that ∫_{-1}^{1} {P_n(x)}² dx = 2/(2n+1), n = 0, 1, 2, ..., where P_n(x) represents the Legendre polynomial of order n.
Find the angle between two lines whose direction cosines are given by the equations l + m + n = 0 and l² + m² - n² = 0.
The projections of a line on the axis are 12, 4, 3. Obtain the length of the line and its direction cosines.
Obtain the equation of the plane which contains the line x = (y-3)/2 = (z-5)/3 and which is perpendicular to the plane 2x + 7y + 3z = 1.
Find the length of shortest distance between the lines (x-8)/3 = (y+9)/-16 = (z-10)/7 and (x-15)/3 = (y-29)/8 = (z-5)/-5.
Show that the lines (x+1)/2 = (y-2)/2 = z/1 and (x-1)/6 = (y+1)/1 = (z-3)/5 are coplanar.
Find the equation of the line of intersection of the planes 2x - y + 2z + 7 = 0 and x + 2y - 3z + 6 = 0.
Define THD and describe the necessity of heat sink in power transistors.
Describe why it is said that 'a transistor in class A amplifier has to work hardest'.
Show that the maximum efficiency of transformer coupled class A amplifier is 50%.
Draw a complementary symmetry push-pull amplifier and define cross-over distortion.
Prove that for the same closed loop gain the closed loop bandwidth for the inverting amplifier is lower than that for the noninverting amplifier.
Design a compensating network for LM307 Op-Amp. The Op-Amp uses ±10V supply voltages.
For the following circuit, determine the maximum frequency that may be used.
Explain the operation of an Op-Amp as current controlled current source.
Explain the application of an Op-Amp as low voltage DC voltmeter.
For the following circuit, Rin = 50Ω, C = 0.5µF, R1 = 200Ω, RF = 2kΩ, RL = 10kΩ, supply voltage = ±15V. Determine the bandwidth of the amplifier.
What is the limitation of an ideal integrator using Om-Amp? How you can overcome it? Explain.
Explain the difference between exclusive-OR gate and edge triggered RS flip-flop-based phase detector point-by-point.
Define diagonal matrix and inverse matrix. Show that if a given square matrix A has an inverse, then it is unique.
Solve the following system of linear equations: x + y - 3z + 2w = 0; 2x - y + 2z - 3w = 0; 3x - 2y + z - 4w = 0; -4x + y - 3z + w = 0
Define rank of a matrix. Find the rank of the matrix A = [[2, 3, -1, -1], [1, -1, -2, -4], [3, 1, 3, -2], [6, 3, 0, -7]].
Find all the eigen values and any one eigen vector of the matrix A = [[3, 1, 1], [1, 5, 1], [1, 1, 3]].
What are the improvements obtained by using negative feedback?
For the voltage series feedback circuit, prove that Z_if = Z_i(1+ βA) and Z_of = Z_o/(1+ βA) where each symbol signifies their usual meaning.
Calculate the voltage gain with and without feedback for the following circuit.
Define gain and phase margin. How Nyquist plot can be useful for checking amplifier stability.
Draw and explain the peak detector circuit by using Op-Amp.
Prove that, an Op-Amp can be used as a negative impedance converter.
Draw the pin configuration of 555 timer. Briefly explain the monostable multivibrator operation of 555 timer.
Briefly explain the operation of phase lock loop with necessary block diagram and functions of each block.
Explain how hysteresis gives a measure of noise immunity to comparator circuits.
Explain the operation of crystal controlled oscillator using a crystal in a series feedback path.
Design a low pass filter at a cut off frequency of 1kHz with a passband gain of 2. Draw the frequency response of the filter. How you can change the cutoff frequency to 1.6kHz?
Explain the Barkhausen criterion and frequency stability. Explain the operation of phase shift oscillator.
